'''2007 Australian Championship''' was a Players Committee constructed event, 1 July 2007, using the pre-reset virtual pool ([[Premiere - Original VS12]]). The deck sheets below are transcribed from the Players Committee's scanned decklist PDF ([[:File:2007 Australian Championship.pdf]]). The PDF is filed as "2007 Provincial Australia"; one sheet calls the event the "Star Wars CCG Australian Champs 1/7/07".

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
* '''Site:''' Australia
* '''Dates:''' 1 July 2007
* '''Winner:''' —
